title: Genjokoan 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett explores Dogen's Genjokoans as a way to live fully present in life, acknowledging that our individual perspectives are inherently incomplete and limited. By embracing this realization, we can approach reality with openness and awareness, rather than trying to change or improve it through thinking. This approach encourages us to focus on the immediate present moment, letting go of assumptions and striving for enlightenment, and instead cultivating a sense of wonder and appreciation for life's complexities.
